promptSuffix: Colour grade: saturated practical light — strobe, neon, stage wash, sodium streetlight. Movement, sweat and energy over polish.

translations.seen vs. invisible: seen by the right people and invisible to everyone else
translations.belong vs. outside: belonging and the memory of being outside it
translations.mainstream vs. counter: the mainstream and everything running counter to it
translations.surface vs. depth: the surface and the depth underneath
translations.loud vs. quiet rebellion: loud rebellion and the quiet kind that lasts longer
translations.known vs. discovered: known to some and discovered by others right now
translations.authentic vs. performed: authentic and the performance of authenticity
translations.local vs. scene: the local and the scene it feeds
translations.night vs. day identity: the night version and the day version of the same person
translations.old school vs. new wave: old school and the new wave that owes it everything
translations.pure vs. sold out: pure and the argument about what that means
translations.insider vs. outsider: inside and the outside pressing against the glass
translations.alone vs. together in it: alone in it and together in it at the same time
translations.signal vs. noise: the signal and the noise you learn to ignore
translations.underground vs. above ground: underground and the world above that doesn't know it exists
translations.passion vs. cool: passion and the cool that tries to hide it
translations.raw vs. polished: raw and the polish that sometimes gets in the way
translations.secret vs. shared: a secret place and the sharing of it with one person
translations.found vs. lost in it: found in it and lost in it at the same time
translations.now vs. then scene: now and then as the same scene at different moments
